body: Makemake system; MK2 thermal contribution separated from primary and ring hypotheses
status: research-only; no new dossier, embedding, catalogue, map, shape or codec changes

paper.title: Prominent mid-infrared excess of the dwarf planet (136472) Makemake discovered by JWST/MIRI indicates ongoing activity
paper.draftHeading: 2024-10-31; received/revised/accepted template dates distinct from observations
paper.assessment: Complete20page author PDF retained; sections2–5 and appendicesB/C/D targeted text and captions assessed. Not a claim to have audited final publisher PDF, all appendices or raw products.
paper.terms: Specific arXiv record CC BY4.0, distinct from Parker2016 nonexclusive distribution and NASA image terms. No figure embedded or blanket data/publisher licence assertion.

observations.epoch: January2023; Table2 source JD midpoints retained, not independently converted to exact UTC
observations.pipeline: 1.15.1, jwst_1256.pmap; author reprocessing uncal→cal without distortion correction
observations.targetAcquisition: F560W LRS acquisition V01254001001P0000000002101 JD2459975.07637 0.058±0.003mJy; separate reflected-light constraint.
observations.association: System thermal fluxes are not resolved moon photometry, local surface temperatures, visible images or independent calibration of Hubble JPEG.

moonModels.absoluteMagnitude: Adopted H_V7.85 from system0.049±0.020 and prior7.8mag contrast; colour transfer/model assumptions distinct from direct F350LP photometry.
moonModels.albedoDiameterAlternatives: Assumed pV0.5/0.1/0.05/0.02 imply diameters51/113/160/253km; not measured axes or silent catalogue updates.
moonModels.NEATM: Model pV0.01/0.02/0.04/0.08 with eta0.6; extreme older pV0.017 eta0.34 still underestimates18micron flux by about an order of magnitude. Historical2016 dark-moon excess hypothesis remains documented but is not unique/currently sufficient within tested models.
moonModels.hypotheticalGiantMoon: Additional1200km/pV0.04/eta0.6 body can match18micron but overpredicts longer wavelengths and lacks observational support. Not a detected second satellite.

primaryAndRingHypotheses.hotspot: Additional blackbody147±5K with projected equivalent radius10.0±0.5km; projection/pole alternatives up to about1percent primary surface. Not resolved hotspot geography, measured moon temperature, local composition or confirmed cryovolcanic eruption/ocean/plume.
primaryAndRingHypotheses.power: Model8.3e9W projected case versus1.5e11W assumed3.5degree polar-region case; conditional geometry, not direct internal heat sensor.
primaryAndRingHypotheses.ring: Undetected carbonaceous100–200nm or graphite200–500nm grain scenarios can reproduce mid-IR spectra within tested assumptions; lifetime/replenishment models not actual ring detection or measured dust chemistry.
primaryAndRingHypotheses.analogs: Enceladus/Pluto/Triton comparisons and Eris/Charon/Quaoar terrain-albedo models do not authorize another body map or assign their geography/chemistry to Makemake or MK2.
primaryAndRingHypotheses.rotation: Primary11.4h default,22.8h alternative remains; not MK2 spin. Constant partial thermal light curve does not prove a ring.
